canon-eos-r10: Liked as a light, compact body with strong autofocus and value; some miss stabilisation.
canon-eos-r100: Praised as a great-value, light entry camera for first or travel use; many find autofocus the weak spot.
canon-eos-r5-mark-ii: Praised for autofocus, pre-capture and high resolution; several criticise video heat and short battery.
canon-eos-r50: Praised for a small, light body and good image quality; several report mode dial or shutter failures.
canon-eos-r50-v: Enjoyed as a small video-first camera with good autofocus; the most common gripe is no viewfinder.
canon-eos-r6-mark-ii: Praised for sticky, fast autofocus and strong low-light files; some find the colours dull or greenish.
canon-eos-r6-mark-iii: Praised for autofocus, pre-capture and strong video; several find high-ISO noise slightly worse.
canon-eos-r7: Liked for crop reach, comfortable grip and good value; many find the autofocus inconsistent.
canon-eos-r8: Praised for full-frame quality in a light, compact body; recurring complaints are short battery and heat.
canon-powershot-v1: Valued as a pocketable video camera with reliable autofocus; many find the battery life short.
dji-osmo-pocket-3: Loved for pocketable size, smooth stabilisation and good video; some find it delicate.
fujifilm-gfx100rf: Praised for image quality and clean high ISO in a compact body; some find the f/4 lens limits low light.
fujifilm-x-e5: Loved as a small, premium-feeling camera with sharp files; several find the battery life weak.
fujifilm-x-half: Enjoyed as a tiny, fun, film-like pocket camera; many find it overpriced for fair image quality.
fujifilm-x-m5: Praised as tiny and light with good colours for everyday carry; the most common regret is no viewfinder.
fujifilm-x-s20: Praised for deep grip, long battery and colours straight out of camera; the top complaint is overheating.
fujifilm-x-t5: Loved for tactile dials, colours and sharp files; the main complaint is autofocus on moving subjects.
fujifilm-x100vi: Loved for small size, colours and film simulations; many find the autofocus slow or unreliable.
gopro-mission-1: Praised for cleaner low-light footage and dynamic range; a couple find it heavier and harder to grade.
insta360-luna-ultra: Praised for clean image quality and strong low light; the leading complaint is overheating on long clips.
insta360-x5: Praised for strong low-light 360 video and sharp images; many find it bulky with laborious editing.
leica-d-lux-8: Loved as a pocketable camera with a sharp zoom and Leica colours; many find the price high.
leica-q3: Praised for its sharp lens, image quality and build; many find autofocus weaker on moving subjects.
leica-q3-43: Loved for an exceptionally sharp lens and fun handling; many find autofocus slow on moving subjects.
leica-q3-monochrom: Praised for low-light performance and tonal black and white files; few real complaints.
nikon-z30: Enjoyed as a small, light camera for travel and vlogging; some miss a viewfinder.
nikon-z50ii: Liked as a light, compact body with autofocus that works on birds and action; many find no stabilisation.
nikon-z5ii: Praised for fast autofocus, low light, handling and value; some find the battery life short.
nikon-z8: Praised as an excellent all-round workhorse with fast tracking autofocus; some find it big and heavy.
nikon-zf: Liked for fast autofocus, low-light files and a fun retro design; many find the shallow grip awkward.
ricoh-gr-iiix: Loved as a truly pocketable camera with sharp images; many find the autofocus weak.
ricoh-gr-iv: Loved as a pocketable camera with a great lens and image quality; some find autofocus slow.
sony-a6700: Praised for superb subject-tracking autofocus in a compact body; the main downside is overheating in 4K.
sony-a7-v: Praised for AI autofocus, pre-capture and fast bursts; a handful report missed focus on fast subjects.
sony-a7c-ii: Liked as one of the smallest full-frame cameras with near automatic autofocus; some find it front-heavy.
sony-rx100-vii: Loved as a pocketable camera with a long zoom and pop-up viewfinder; a few find it fragile or slow.
